# Support spoke learn manifests in local Portal and SEO generators

> **v14.0.0 Sprint Pickup (`2026-11-22`):** Operator lifted the temporary Engine hold for the 24h `v14.0.0` convergence sprint (`SEO` + `Portal Learning` explicitly in scope), and all non-Engine leaves of #21847 (`neomjs/devindex#162`, `neomjs/neo-agent-institution#1037`, `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1892`, `neomjs/middleware-v2#105`, and `neomjs/pages#160`) are now **MERGED**.
>
> **Cycle-1 Scope Restatement (`2026-11-22`, PR #21909 review `6013034812`):** `neomjs/pages#158` / `neomjs/pages#160` (`buildScripts/materializeLearnSpokes.mjs`) already owns single-source hub+spoke `learn/tree.json` composition, hub+spoke route-collision guards, and spoke commit `<lastmod>` stamping into `seo.json`. Engine `#21848` owns the Engine/Portal side without duplicating `materializeLearnSpokes.mjs` or reading unweighted file `mtime`: the `AgentInterfaces` root label, `findUnlistedLearnMarkdownFiles` orphan guard + removal of the two unlisted `learn/agentos/tooling/*` files, `/learn/institution/*` `<title>` qualification in `seoJson.mjs`, `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md`, the `19`-target canonical link rewrite + `Portal.view.learn.Component#rewriteLinks` in-SPA upgrade, and `#20527` cockpit question-owner disambiguation.

## Context

Graduated Engine/Portal leaf of `neomjs/neo` Discussion #20920 (`A0 + A1` Multi-Repo Guide Restore Slice, #21847). With `neomjs/pages#160` merged to compose the `95` federated spoke guides (`62` `neo-agent-brain` + `26` `devindex` + `7` `neo-agent-institution`) into the single `229`-leaf Portal Learn tree (`134 -> 229` leaves), `neomjs/neo`'s Portal Learn experience, Engine-side prose links, cross-repo cockpit guide boundaries, unlisted-orphan guard, and `/learn/institution/*` SEO title qualification must cohere as one front door (#20498, #20527, `neomjs/neo#adr:neo-identity-source-of-truth-model` OD-4).

## The Problem

1. **Hub Navigation Label & Reader-Path Coherence (#20498, [#discussioncomment-19803727](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/20920#discussioncomment-19803727)):**
   - All `95` restored spoke guides enter the single Portal Learn tree (`neomjs/pages#160`), growing `learn/tree.json` from `134` leaves to **`229` leaves**.
   - `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md` still describes `"ten sections"`, `"14 focused pages"`, and the third reader's path by the pre-restore `134`-leaf shape.
   - `neomjs/neo/learn/` currently leaves `neomjs.com` **`89` times** for `github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-brain/.../learn/*` (`35` targets, **`19` of which are in the `62`-guide Brain restore set** — including `36` links in `learn/benefits/ArchitectureOverview.md` and `8` in `learn/benefits/Introduction.md`). Unless rewritten to canonical `https://neomjs.com/learn/...` URLs (and routed in-SPA by `Portal.view.learn.Component#rewriteLinks` when the leaf is loaded in the Learn tree store), the front door keeps sending readers off-site to GitHub for guides `neomjs.com` now hosts.
2. **Cross-Repo Question Collisions on Cockpit Guides (#20527 precedent, [#discussioncomment-19803727](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/20920#discussioncomment-19803727)):**
   - Zero URL path collisions is not zero reader-question collisions: sharing one `AgentInterfaces` shelf puts `neomjs/neo`'s `agentos/RunningTheFleetCockpit` (`15 KB`) beside `Institution`'s `RunningTheInstitution` (*"how do I run the cockpit"*), and `neomjs/neo`'s `agentos/FleetManagerArchitecture` (`28 KB`) beside `Institution`'s `Introduction` and `CockpitTour` (*"what is the cockpit"*).
3. **Two Unlisted Orphan `.md` Files & Institution Spoke `<title>` Qualification (`STEP_BACK` point 4):**
   - `learn/agentos/tooling/GenesisNeuralLinkProbe.md` (`301 -> /learn/agentos/NeuralLink` in `neomjs/middleware-v2#105`) and `learn/agentos/tooling/ChromeDevToolsMcpServer.md` (`410` in `neomjs/middleware-v2#105`) still sit unlisted on disk in `neomjs/neo/learn/agentos/tooling/`.
   - Spoke composition, collision guards, and spoke commit `<lastmod>` stamping live in `neomjs/pages#160` (`buildScripts/materializeLearnSpokes.mjs`); Engine `seoJson.mjs` still needs `/learn/institution/*` search-intent `<title>` qualification (`| Neo.mjs Agent Institution`) when `pages` runs `generate.mjs`.

## The Architectural Reality

- Hub parent, order, and label rules (`#20498` & `neomjs/neo#adr:neo-identity-source-of-truth-model` OD-4, [#discussioncomment-19803727](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/20920#discussioncomment-19803727), [#discussioncomment-19804194](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/20920#discussioncomment-19804194)):
  - Composed in production by `neomjs/pages#160` (`buildScripts/materializeLearnSpokes.mjs`): Brain `benefits/brain/*` (`6`) under `Benefits` > `"The Brain - Agent OS"`, Brain `agentos/*` (`56`) under `AgentInterfaces` (`3` groups) + Institution (`7`) as `"Agent Institution"` (ADR 0018 OD-4), and DevIndex (`26`) under `Guides` > `"DevIndex App"`.
  - Root label of `AgentInterfaces` in `learn/tree.json` (`"Brain Interface, Fleet & Agent Tooling"`) is verified directly against the desktop + phone frames.
- Link-resolver invariant (`buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` & `apps/portal/view/learn/Component.mjs`): bare root-absolute `/learn/...` links break on GitHub (`github.com/learn/...` -> `404`) and are rejected by `check-relative-links.mjs`. Canonical `https://neomjs.com/learn/<id>` links resolve cleanly on GitHub, in Googlebot SSR, and under `check-relative-links.mjs`, while `Portal.view.learn.Component#rewriteLinks` routes them in-SPA (`#/learn/<id>`) whenever `store.get(id)` is present in the loaded Learn tree store (keeping external fallback in standalone Engine-only checkouts).

## The Fix

1. **Hub Root Label, Orphan Guard, & Institution `<title>` Qualification (`learn/tree.json`, `buildScripts/docs/seo/learnSpokes.mjs`, `seoJson.mjs`, `generate.mjs`, `verify.mjs`):**
   - Update `AgentInterfaces` root label in `learn/tree.json` to `"Brain Interface, Fleet & Agent Tooling"` (leaving hub+spoke tree composition, collision checking, and spoke commit `<lastmod>` stamping in `neomjs/pages#160` `materializeLearnSpokes.mjs` as the single composer).
   - Remove the two unlisted orphan files `learn/agentos/tooling/GenesisNeuralLinkProbe.md` and `learn/agentos/tooling/ChromeDevToolsMcpServer.md` (`check-relative-links.mjs` proves nothing points at them) and add `findUnlistedLearnMarkdownFiles` in `learnSpokes.mjs` + a fail-closed check in `verify.mjs` rejecting unlisted `.md` orphans in `learn/`.
   - Qualify `/learn/institution/*` `<title>` tags in `seoJson.mjs` (`formatLearnSeoTitle`) with `| Neo.mjs Agent Institution`.
2. **`learn/UsingTheseTopics.md`, `Portal.view.learn.Component#rewriteLinks`, & `19`-Target On-Site Link Rewrite:**
   - Update `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md` section/page counts and third-reader path to reflect the `229`-leaf tree.
   - Rewrite all outbound `github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-brain/.../learn/*` links in non-blog `neomjs/neo/learn/` guides targeting any of the `19` restored Brain guides (including `learn/benefits/ArchitectureOverview.md` and `learn/benefits/Introduction.md`) to canonical `https://neomjs.com/learn/...` URLs, with `Portal.view.learn.Component#rewriteLinks` upgrading them to in-SPA `#/learn/...` navigation whenever the target leaf is loaded in the Portal Learn tree store.
3. **`#20527` Cross-Repo Cockpit Question-Owner Table & Cross-Linking:**
   - Produce and enforce a `#20527`-style one-owner-per-question table (`question | owning page | companion pages that link to it`) resolving the overlap between `agentos/RunningTheFleetCockpit` vs `institution/RunningTheInstitution` and `agentos/FleetManagerArchitecture` vs `institution/Introduction` + `institution/CockpitTour`, adding explicit cross-links in `RunningTheFleetCockpit.md` and `FleetManagerArchitecture.md`.
4. **Visual Look Verification (`#20498`):**
   - Capture frames of the Portal Learn nav collapsed (including the released `/learn/UsingTheseTopics` baseline beside the changed page) and with the `AgentInterfaces` root expanded across **desktop + phone** and **dark + light** themes on the composed `229`-leaf tree, verifying the root label fits cleanly and each of the three `#20498` reader paths reaches its first page in **`<= 2` clicks**.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `learn/tree.json` names the `AgentInterfaces` root `"Brain Interface, Fleet & Agent Tooling"` for the `229`-leaf tree composed by `neomjs/pages#160` (`materializeLearnSpokes.mjs`, which owns spoke mount order and hub+spoke route-collision guards), removes the two unlisted orphans (`GenesisNeuralLinkProbe.md` & `ChromeDevToolsMcpServer.md`), and enforces `findUnlistedLearnMarkdownFiles` in `verify.mjs` (`Verify.spec.mjs` + `check-relative-links.mjs` green).
- [ ] `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md` reflects the `229`-leaf structure, all outbound `github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-brain/.../learn/*` links in non-blog `neomjs/neo/learn/` guides targeting the `19` restored Brain guides (`ArchitectureOverview.md`, `Introduction.md`, etc.) resolve to canonical `https://neomjs.com/learn/...` URLs, and `Portal.view.learn.Component#rewriteLinks` routes them in-SPA (`#/learn/...`) when loaded in the Portal Learn tree store.
- [ ] PR includes the released `/learn/UsingTheseTopics` frame beside the changed state plus desktop + phone frames in dark + light themes showing the composed `229`-leaf Learn nav collapsed and with the agent root open (confirming the root label), and verifies each of the 3 reader paths reaches its first page in `<= 2` clicks.
- [ ] Explicit `#20527` one-owner-per-question table (`question | owner | companions linking to it`) resolves overlapping answers across `agentos/RunningTheFleetCockpit` vs `institution/RunningTheInstitution` and `agentos/FleetManagerArchitecture` vs `institution/Introduction` + `institution/CockpitTour`, with companion cross-links in `RunningTheFleetCockpit.md` and `FleetManagerArchitecture.md`.
- [ ] `seoJson.mjs` (`formatLearnSeoTitle`) qualifies `/learn/institution/*` `<title>` tags with `| Neo.mjs Agent Institution` while leaving spoke commit `<lastmod>` stamping in `neomjs/pages#160` (`materializeLearnSpokes.mjs`) and keeping hub leaves free of file-`mtime` `<lastmod>` fallback (`Generate.spec.mjs` green).

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] After deployment on `neomjs.com`, verify all `14` pre-split ranking `/learn/*` URLs listed on #21847 return `HTTP 200` (or `301 -> 200`), and re-check `sc-domain:neomjs.com` at the 28-day `revalidationTrigger` (`2026-12-19`) for `0` remaining `404` rows.

## Out of Scope

- Adding `neo-agent-brain`, `devindex`, or `neo-agent-institution` to `neomjs/neo/package.json`, or duplicating `neomjs/pages` `buildScripts/materializeLearnSpokes.mjs` inside `neomjs/neo`.
- Docs App v2 (`B2`) class prerendering.

## Avoided Traps

- **Duplicating `neomjs/pages` `materializeLearnSpokes.mjs` or adding a `.git`-less file-`mtime` `<lastmod>` fallback in `seoJson.mjs`:** creates a second uncalled composer and dates hub leaves by checkout `mtime` when `.git` is absent (`neomjs/pages#160` already stamps spoke commit dates into `seo.json`).
- **Writing bare root-absolute `/learn/...` Markdown links:** fails `check-relative-links.mjs` and `404`s on GitHub (`github.com/learn/...`); use `https://neomjs.com/learn/...` with `Portal.view.learn.Component#rewriteLinks` in-SPA upgrade.
- **Putting ticket/discussion `#N` citations inside source comments or `learn/guides/**`:** fails `Shared PR Baseline / Source comment archaeology` and `ai:lint-guides`.
